newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela to sell Banco Republica in March-April.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela to sell Banco Republica in March-April.

text.p: Venezuela's state Deposits Guarantee Fund (FOGADE) plans to sell state-owned Banco Republica next March or April, FOGADE President Esther de Margulis said Wednesday.

"Taking into account that January is a month of little activity, we calculate that we will be able to sell Republica in March or April," de Margulis said during a breakfast meeting with a small group of foreign journalists.

Banco Republica fell into FOGADE's hands in January 1995 during the collapse of the Latinoamericana-Progreso Group of Cuban-born banker Orlando Castro. Castro is currently on trial in the United States on charges of fraud.
France's Banque Paribas is acting as an assessor for the sale and valuation of Banco Republica, de Margulis said.
